video_title: Walker Kessler Invited Me To His New House In LA!

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on his mindset heading into the upcoming NBA season
quotes.excerpt: I'm just going into the season ready to compete, ready to run through a brick wall.
quotes.quote: For me personally, I'm just going into the season ready to compete, ready to run through a brick wall, and get a win. I think I play my best basketball when I just focus on that. The Lakers legacy is unreal and historic, but for me, I'm just going to do my thing and that's just competing to win.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on his recovery and returning to play this season
quotes.excerpt: This offseason was unique in the fact that I was injured all last season.
quotes.quote: This offseason was unique in the fact that I was injured all last season. So I would say this offseason, getting back live feel, getting back to playing.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler identifies Nikola Jokic as the toughest player to guard
quotes.excerpt: Probably Jokic, because his ability just to affect the game in so many ways.
quotes.quote: Probably Jokic, because his ability just to affect the game in so many ways. I've covered Kyrie a couple times on switches, he's very shifty, obviously.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on his commitment to competing for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to run through a brick wall, have a blast doing it, play to win.
quotes.quote: I've said it before, but so ready to just go out there and compete again. I'm going to run through a brick wall, have a blast doing it, play to win, do the dirty stuff. I know my role and I'm excited to win.
